use.flag: Route ALSA playback to PipeWire (requires media-video/pipewire with USE=pipewire-alsa)

pkgmetadata.longdescription: EffectCraft is a clean-room reimplementation of an After Effects-style motion graphics and visual effects compositor in pure Rust. Installed from the upstream Linux tarball; the binary only links against glibc and loads the graphics libraries at runtime. Early alpha.
